svg.title: FieldProof commercial path: one relationship before a network
svg.desc: The commercial hypothesis starts with paid integration for one fleet and one authorized facility. A second independent facility tests integration reuse. Dock, charger, elevator, and other services are future candidates. Enterprise fees precede recurring software fees and transaction fees. The potential network effect depends on repeated use and actual provider revenue.

g.text: One fleet. One operator. Then test reuse.
Earn the first service relationship before building a marketplace.
Test reusable integration across independent facilities.
Measure repeated use, useful evidence, and budget.
Expose one permitted service to approved buyers.
Measure delivery, support, and recovery costs.
Expansion candidates / separate contracts and adapters required
Integration + support → recurring software → fees on real service volume
More authorized endpoints → more useful fleet integration → repeated transactions
→ actual provider revenue → more operators connect existing infrastructure
No customer, service revenue, pricing validation, or commercial network exists today.
